title: Hamas Accuses Israel of Using Palestinian Deaths as Electoral Fuel
detail: A Hamas leader accused Israel of exploiting Palestinian deaths in Gaza as political fuel ahead of Israeli elections, framing ongoing military operations as driven by domestic electoral calculations rather than genuine security objectives. The accusation echoes earlier remarks by US envoy Jared Kushner, who in early September called Israel's government 'a little irrational' on Gaza because of the upcoming vote.

title: Displaced Palestinians Describe Empty Hands, No Food or Shelter
detail: An Al Jazeera feature report documents first-hand testimony from displaced Palestinians struggling to survive amid ongoing war and displacement. With food supplies blocked and shelter unavailable, survivors describe a humanitarian crisis of profound scale — 'my hands are empty' — as displacement compounds acute shortages across the Gaza Strip.

media.caption: Displaced Palestinians struggle to find food and shelter amid the ongoing conflict

title: Hamas Chief: Palestinians Have Suffered Under Every Israeli Governing Party
detail: Hamas chief Yahya Sinwar's successor stated that Palestinians have suffered under every Israeli governing party, framing the conflict as structural rather than tied to any single government or coalition. The statement pushes back against narratives that a change in Israeli leadership alone could resolve the conflict.

title: Gaza War Death Toll Crosses 74,000 — Palestinian Health Ministry
detail: The Palestinian Health Ministry reported the cumulative Gaza war death toll has crossed 74,000 since October 7, 2023. The milestone underscores the scale of the conflict now in its fourth year, with the toll climbing steadily despite the October 2025 ceasefire agreement, which has been violated daily for over 350 consecutive days.

title: IDF Reports Killing Hamas Commander in Targeted Strike in Gaza Strip
detail: The Israel Defense Forces reported killing a Hamas commander in the Gaza Strip in a targeted strike on September 27, 2026. The operation continues a pattern of high-value targeted assassinations by Israeli forces against Hamas military leadership during the ongoing conflict, occurring despite the October 2025 ceasefire framework which has been violated for over 350 consecutive days.

title: Egypt's Spy Chief Warned Israel Gaza Was 'On the Verge of Exploding' Before October 7
detail: A report reveals Egypt's intelligence chief warned Israel that Gaza was 'on the verge of exploding' before the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack. The disclosure raises accountability questions about whether Israeli leadership failed to act on credible pre-attack warnings, adding to earlier reports of intelligence failures in the lead-up to the deadliest attack in Israel's history.

media.caption: Egypt's intelligence chief had warned Israel of Hamas escalation before October 7, 2023
